requirements.name: Incarnate manifestation and useful faction-dependent output
requirements.sourceEstablished: The selected direction is a finite source-owned manifestation, not a transported leader, copied institution or free official. Generic companion defaults do not supply its printed AC/HP/attack die or faction-dependent useful powers.
smallestContract: Identify the supported faction input and exactly how its power changes the manifestation/actions/support; no invented faction or copied institutional knowledge.

Complete body identity/type/anatomy/occupied volume/support, AC/HP/defenses, attributes/checks/saves, movement/senses/communication and action targeting/range/reach/resolution/output. Adopt applicable published defaults explicitly rather than borrowing a comparator profile.

Enumerate finite uses, capacities, equipment and intrinsic versus independently owned cargo; define whose body/source/dealer acts. No inherited Paragon/Champion damage, healing, gear, institutional resources or permissions.
requirements.whoCanResolve: An expressly authorized Incarnate-only design contract can supply the missing mechanics; actual faction facts and any institution-owned power or permission require their own source authority.

requirements.name: Invocation and actual faction/caster relationship
requirements.sourceEstablished: Current reputation records identify faction keys and scales, not Incarnate invocation permission or an actually acquired cast. Ally membership and Champion allied/positive-standing/permission predicates remain specific to those spells.
smallestContract: State an explicit Incarnate admission predicate and relevant caster/recipient/faction relationship. Do not automatically impose or waive membership, allied status, standing thresholds, consent or an aid ban by analogy.

Bind one actually supported canonical faction ID, provenance and the actual relationship/permission records needed by that selected predicate; draft entries and missing records cannot supply them. No institutional history, member, resource or authority is invented.

Bind a source-legal Druid/Mage/Wizard Conjuration rank9 caster at class17+, with acquisition and prepared/known status, profile, actual Action/V/S/F, range/space, RP and concentration history. Access eligibility alone is not acquisition or current permission.
requirements.whoCanResolve: Director-authored admission mechanics must be explicit. Real faction and caster relationship/acquisition facts must come from authorized records; this return supplies neither.

requirements.name: Complete profile-specific lifecycle plus two paid useful encounters
requirements.sourceEstablished: Native concentration up to one minute is already specified. The source supplies owner-attached phases, Bonus Action commands, shared offensive limits, default behavior and ordinary summon restrictions; these are not missing source facts.
smallestContract: Map every W01 action/support option to the shared command/offense budgets, owner-relative phase, command range/perception, expiry, default movement/Dodge and any explicitly authorized Reaction. No new independent turn, fourth action, refresh or banked command.

Explicitly bind this recipient to the relevant healing/type/ordinary-zero/qualifying-Null contract, its causal settlement and source ending. Named AC4/AC5 healing or Null outcomes do not transfer automatically. Bind real healing/damage sources and their exact eligible recipients.

Keep the original resolution+60-second maximum and actual concentration ending; specify standing/permission changes, suppression/resumption, dispel/replacement, finite-resource conservation, death/ending and intrinsic-versus-borrowed gear/return settlement. No refill, paused deadline, revived ended source, duplicate cargo or retroactive institutional event.

Demonstrate two useful complete paid encounters, exercising supported faction actions/support and the meaningful command/default, shared-budget, healing/ordinary-zero/Null, standing, suppression/expiry and custody branches. Record source-qualified actors, actual resource/counter histories, exact schedules, before/after states and reversible operations.
requirements.whoCanResolve: A scoped Incarnate lifecycle mapping can be authored; valid actual actor, source, faction and custody records plus executed integrated witnesses must then demonstrate it.

wholeSpellGateReason: Missing mechanics define the native useful manifestation and its invocation, not merely an optional external edge case. No complete paid positive encounter exists in this packet.
minimumNextAction: Supply one focused authorized Incarnate profile/admission/lifecycle contract plus actual source-qualified faction/caster facts, then the two complete paid witnesses. Do not resubmit unchanged gate traces.
